Guideline: Bridge Rust and Qt 6.8+ safely with KDAB cxx-qt
Description: submodules/cxx-qt generates safe bidirectional C++/Rust bindings for QObject properties (#[qproperty]), invokables (#[qinvokable]) and signals (#[qsignal])
Do: Define QObject models in Rust with #[cxx_qt::bridge] and expose reactive #[qproperty] fields to QML
Don't: Write raw unsafe C++ extern "C" FFI glue or mutate QObjects from non-Qt threads
Code Good: #[cxx_qt::bridge] mod ffi { #[qobject] #[derive(Default)] pub struct AppState { #[qproperty] count: i32 } }

Guideline: Use the M3Theme.qml singleton generated by yolo-emit
Description: crates/yolo-emit (--target qml) emits a pragma Singleton M3Theme.qml with all 37 M3 color roles reactive to Application.styleHints.colorScheme
Do: Bind QML Controls and Kirigami colors to M3Theme.primary, M3Theme.surface, M3Theme.onSurface and M3Theme.surfaceContainer
Don't: Hardcode hex strings (#1d1b20) inside individual QML files
Code Good: Rectangle { color: M3Theme.surfaceContainer; Text { color: M3Theme.onSurface } }

Guideline: Use QtQuick.Controls Material style + KDE Kirigami
Description: catalog/conversion.toml maps M3 components onto QtQuick.Controls (Material.Filled, Material.Outlined, Material.roundedScale) and Kirigami (GlobalDrawer, Card, SearchField)
Do: Use QtQuick.Controls and org.kde.kirigami for adaptive desktop/mobile layouts
Don't: Mix legacy QtWidgets (QWidget/QMainWindow) with modern QML scenes unnecessarily
Code Good: Button { text: "Save"; highlighted: true; Material.accent: M3Theme.primary }
Code Bad: // mixing QWidget dialogs inside a QQuickWindow

Guideline: Use CxxQtThread to marshal async Rust results back to the Qt GUI thread
Description: QObjects have strict thread affinity to the Qt main thread; background Rust tokio tasks must queue updates via qt_thread.queue()
Do: Capture self.qt_thread() before spawning background work and call qt_thread.queue(|mut qobject| { ... })
Don't: Access or mutate Pin<&mut T> QObject pointers from another thread
Code Good: let qt_thread = self.qt_thread(); std::thread::spawn(move || { qt_thread.queue(|mut obj| obj.set_ready(true)).unwrap(); });

Guideline: Implement QAbstractListModel in Rust for large datasets
Description: Passing QList<QVariant> arrays across FFI on every change copies the entire list and rebuilds QML delegates
Do: Subclass QAbstractListModel in cxx-qt and emit dataChanged / beginInsertRows for incremental updates
Don't: Expose a #[qproperty] Vec/QList of 500+ items that replaces the whole property on each edit
Code Good: // QAbstractListModel with roleNames and incremental beginInsertRows
Code Bad: // replacing a 1000-element QStringList property on every keystroke

Guideline: Use RowLayout / ColumnLayout / GridLayout with Kirigami.Units
Description: QtQuick.Layouts handles DPI-aware resizing; Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing (4px) and largeSpacing (8px) match the Yolo UI spacing scale
Do: Use ColumnLayout and Layout.fillWidth: true with Kirigami.Units spacing
Don't: Position responsive form controls with fixed x/y pixel coordinates
Code Good: ColumnLayout { spacing: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing; TextField { Layout.fillWidth: true } }

Guideline: Attach Accessible.role and Accessible.name in QML
Description: Qt Quick exposes AT-SPI (Linux), UI Automation (Windows) and NSAccessibility (macOS) through the Accessible attached property
Do: Set Accessible.name and Accessible.role on custom items and icon-only ToolButtons
Don't: Ship custom MouseArea components without keyboard focus or Accessible metadata
Code Bad: Rectangle { MouseArea { onClicked: deleteItem() } } // invisible to screen readers

Guideline: Support hyprqt6engine and KDE ColorScheme on Linux Wayland
Description: crates/yolo-emit generates both YoloUiM3.colors (KDE) and hyprqt6engine palettes so Qt6 apps match Hyprland and Plasma natively
Do: Respect Application.styleHints.colorScheme and QPalette roles instead of overriding platform integration
Don't: Force QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb when running on a native Wayland compositor
Code Good: readonly property bool dark: Application.styleHints.colorScheme === Qt.ColorScheme.Dark

Guideline: Compile React/Shadcn TSX to Qt6 QML via yolo-migrate
Description: crates/yolo-migrator (--target qml) lowers React/Shadcn/Radix/Base UI TSX into Qt 6.8+ Qt Quick Controls Material + Kirigami QML
Do: Run bun ui migrate <Component.tsx> --target qml to generate clean QML components with typed signals
Don't: Hand-port JSX layouts to QML without mapping Tailwind spacing and M3 tokens
Code Good: bun ui migrate AudioSettings.tsx --target qml --preset neutral
Code Bad: // manual QML port with hardcoded pixel anchors
